description: This file manages web search provider plugins, including caching, plugin resolution, and registry handling within the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: resetWebSearchProviderSnapshotCacheForTests
methods.description: Resets the in-memory cache used for web search provider snapshots, primarily for testing purposes.

methods.name: buildWebSearchSnapshotCacheKey
methods.description: Constructs a cache key string based on provided parameters for caching web search provider snapshots.

methods.name: pluginManifestDeclaresWebSearch
methods.description: Determines if a plugin manifest declares web search providers via its contracts or config UI hints.

methods.name: resolveWebSearchCandidatePluginIds
methods.description: Resolves plugin IDs that declare web search capabilities, filtered by optional plugin ID list.

methods.name: resolveWebSearchLoadOptions
methods.description: Builds options for loading web search plugins, including environment, config, and activation settings.

methods.name: mapRegistryWebSearchProviders
methods.description: Maps plugin registry entries to web search provider entries, optionally filtering by plugin IDs.

methods.name: resolvePluginWebSearchProviders
methods.description: Resolves web search providers, utilizing caching and plugin registry resolution.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeWebSearchProviders
methods.description: Resolves web search providers from the runtime plugin registry or falls back to standard resolution.
